secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (Dashboard → Project Settings → API). The app's whole backend (Postgres/Auth/Realtime) runs on this external project; no local DB in compose.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase publishable/anon key. Remapped to VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY for the browser client by .base44/dev.sh.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service_role/secret key (server-only). Remapped to SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY in .base44/dev.sh for the daily-interest batch job in server.ts.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_JWKS_URL
secrets.description: Supabase JWKS URL. Not read by this app's code; kept because it is stored for the app.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional. Telegram bot token from @BotFather for the CSKH ↔ Telegram bridge in server.ts. Auto-disables when empty.

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID
secrets.description: Optional. Telegram chat/group ID the support bot posts to. Auto-disables when empty.

secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Google Gemini key for the /api/market-search endpoint; only errors when that endpoint is called.
